QuestInfo.name: Support for Lv. 70 Resistance members.
QuestInfo.0: #bCassandra#k is giving out an #r#eunusual gift#n#k to Resistance members who've reached Lv. 70. Go see her once you reach Lv. 70.
QuestInfo.2: You received an item that will help your development, but it can't be used yet. You must wait until Jan 19.

0.0: Congratulations on reaching Level 70. You've become an awesome Resistance member! So, I have prepared a #rspecial gift#k unlike anything you've ever seen. Will you accept the gift?

yes.0: Come see me, Cassandra, at any of the nearest towns. I'll be waiting!

no.0: The gift event will be going on until Jan 18, so please come see me anytime.

1.0: Well, you cannot use it yet, you have to wait until #bJan 19#k to use it. The item's effect is...a secret! You will find out when the time comes. But, remember that this item expires on #bFeb 28#k. Also, you can receive an #bEnergy Capsule for All#k as a gift when you reach Level 80, so try hard! Good luck!
